verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a POS and inventory product, but the evidence pack documents no capability to select or edit many items at once. The closest items are adjacent rather than bulk-editing features. Sidekick auto-creates recommended stock transfers, Quick counts updates stock by scanning items, and POS UI extensions can call the GraphQL Admin API, which is a developer building block.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
